verdict.rationale: A derivative ecosystem of community fine-tunes, quantizations or replicas is a fair question for any AI model product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no public weights, hub-hosted derivatives, or official-versus-unofficial attribution. Anthropic's transparency material describes protecting model weights rather than releasing them, so the story is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a real derivative ecosystem exists around the model — community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations on public hubs — with clear attribution of what is and is not official
